form_fields.name: username
form_fields.label: 用户名
form_fields.description: 用于连接 MySQL 数据库的用户名
form_fields.guide_short: 建议使用专用只读监控账号。默认采集至少需要 PROCESS，以及对 performance_schema / information_schema 的 SELECT；开启 Binary Log 或主从/副本状态时还需 REPLICATION CLIENT。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Use a dedicated read-only account. Default collection needs PROCESS plus SELECT on required performance_schema / information_schema objects; enable REPLICATION CLIENT when gathering binary logs or replica status.

form_fields.name: ENV_PASSWORD
form_fields.label: 密码
form_fields.description: 用于连接 MySQL 数据库的密码
form_fields.guide_short: 填写与用户名对应的登录密码，注意不要带入首尾空格或换行；MySQL 8.0 默认 caching_sha2_password，请确认采集端驱动兼容。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the password for the username without leading or trailing spaces or line breaks. For MySQL 8.0 caching_sha2_password, confirm collector-driver compatibility.

form_fields.name: host
form_fields.label: 主机
form_fields.description: 与设备进行通信的主机
form_fields.guide_short: 填写 MySQL 实例的 IP 或域名，例如 10.0.0.10；保存前可在采集节点用 mysql -h <host> -u <user> -p 验证连通。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the MySQL instance IP address or hostname, such as 10.0.0.10, and verify connectivity from the collector node with an interactive mysql login.

form_fields.name: port
form_fields.label: 端口
form_fields.description: 与设备进行通信的端口
form_fields.guide_short: MySQL 服务监听端口，默认 3306；若修改过 my.cnf 的 port，请填写实际端口；本端口与任何 exporter 端口无关。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Enter the actual MySQL listener port, commonly 3306. If my.cnf changes the port, use that value; it is unrelated to any exporter port.

form_fields.name: interval
form_fields.label: 间隔
form_fields.description: 监控数据的采集时间间隔（单位：秒）
form_fields.guide_short: 默认 60 秒；过低会增加 MySQL 实例压力，过高会延误告警；建议不少于 30 秒。
form_fields.guide_short_en: The default is 60 seconds. Short intervals increase MySQL load, while long intervals delay alerts; use at least 30 seconds.

form_fields.name: gather_process_list
form_fields.label: 进程列表
form_fields.description: 采集线程空闲、执行中、等锁等进程状态。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认开启。对应 SHOW PROCESSLIST 汇总，仪表盘「线程分布」依赖此项，需 PROCESS 权限。开启后可采 mysql_process_list_*（如 threads_idle / executing / sending_data / waiting_for_lock）。关闭后上述指标为空，连接数、QPS 等 STATUS 指标仍可采。
form_fields.guide_short_en: On by default. SHOW PROCESSLIST aggregates for dashboard thread distribution; needs PROCESS. Metrics: mysql_process_list_* (idle/executing/sending/waiting). Turning off clears those only; STATUS metrics like connections/QPS still collect.
form_fields.description_en: Collect process-list thread states such as idle, executing, and waiting for lock.

form_fields.name: gather_innodb_metrics
form_fields.label: InnoDB 指标
form_fields.description: 采集缓冲池与 InnoDB 读写、行锁等性能指标。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认开启。仪表盘 InnoDB/缓冲池相关图依赖此项。开启后可采 mysql_innodb_*、mysql_buffer_pool_*（命中率、脏页、行锁等待、读写与 fsync 等）。关闭后上述指标为空，连接与 QPS 等仍可采。
form_fields.guide_short_en: On by default. Dashboard InnoDB/buffer pool panels depend on it. Metrics: mysql_innodb_*, mysql_buffer_pool_* (hit/dirty ratio, row-lock waits, IO/fsync). STATUS metrics still collect when off.
form_fields.description_en: Collect buffer pool and InnoDB IO/row-lock performance metrics.

form_fields.name: gather_global_variables
form_fields.label: 全局变量
form_fields.description: 采集连接上限、缓存容量、读写角色等配置类指标。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认开启。连接使用率、打开文件使用率、表缓存使用率等「当前值/上限」类图依赖此项。开启后可采 mysql_variables_*（如 max_connections、table_open_cache、open_files_limit、tmp/innodb 缓冲池大小、read_only、log_bin）。关闭后配置类指标为空，纯 STATUS 计数仍可采。
form_fields.guide_short_en: On by default. Utilization charts that divide by limits need it. Metrics: mysql_variables_* (max_connections, caches, open_files_limit, buffer sizes, read_only, log_bin). Raw STATUS counters still collect when off.
form_fields.description_en: Collect config metrics such as connection limits, cache sizes, and read-only role.

form_fields.name: gather_binary_logs
form_fields.label: Binary Log
form_fields.description: 采集 binlog 文件数量与总大小。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。执行 SHOW BINARY LOGS，可采 mysql_binary_files_count、mysql_binary_size_bytes。仅实例已开 binlog 且账号有 REPLICATION CLIENT 时再开，否则连通测试/采集会失败。是否已开 binlog 可看全局变量 log_bin（需开启「全局变量」）。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. Metrics: mysql_binary_files_count, mysql_binary_size_bytes via SHOW BINARY LOGS. Enable only with binary logging on and REPLICATION CLIENT; otherwise detect/collection fails. Check log_bin via Global Variables.
form_fields.description_en: Collect binary log file count and total size.

form_fields.name: gather_slave_status
form_fields.label: Slave 状态
form_fields.description: 采集传统主从复制延迟与 IO/SQL 线程状态。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。传统 SHOW SLAVE STATUS（MySQL 5.7 / 部分 MariaDB）。开启后可采 mysql_slave_seconds_behind_master、mysql_slave_io_running、mysql_slave_sql_running。仅从库需要复制监控时开启，需 REPLICATION CLIENT；非复制实例开启可能导致采集失败。MySQL 8+ 也可改用「Replica 状态」。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. Classic SHOW SLAVE STATUS. Metrics: mysql_slave_seconds_behind_master, mysql_slave_io_running, mysql_slave_sql_running. For replicas only; needs REPLICATION CLIENT. Non-replicas may fail. On MySQL 8+ you may use Replica Status instead.
form_fields.description_en: Collect classic replication lag and IO/SQL thread status.

form_fields.name: gather_replica_status
form_fields.label: Replica 状态
form_fields.description: 采集 MySQL 8+ 复制延迟与线程状态。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。面向 MySQL 8+ SHOW REPLICA STATUS，指标与 Slave 状态同类（复制延迟、IO/SQL 线程）。需 REPLICATION CLIENT；与「Slave 状态」按目标版本择一即可，一般不必两个都开。非复制实例开启可能导致采集失败。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. MySQL 8+ SHOW REPLICA STATUS for lag/thread state (same class as slave metrics). Needs REPLICATION CLIENT. Prefer one of Slave or Replica by version; non-replicas may fail.
form_fields.description_en: Collect MySQL 8+ replication lag and thread status.

form_fields.name: gather_table_io_waits
form_fields.label: 表 IO Wait
form_fields.description: 采集各表读写删除等 IO 等待情况。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。依赖 performance_schema 表 IO 汇总。开启后可采 mysql_table_io_waits_*（fetch/insert/update/delete 次数与耗时汇总）。未启用或不具备 SELECT 权限时可能导致采集失败；按表产生序列，适合排查热点表，日常默认不必开。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. Metrics: mysql_table_io_waits_* (fetch/insert/update/delete counts and time) from PERFORMANCE_SCHEMA. Needs performance_schema and SELECT; may fail otherwise. Per-table series—use for hot-table diagnosis, keep off for routine monitoring.
form_fields.description_en: Collect per-table IO wait for read/write/delete operations.

form_fields.name: gather_table_lock_waits
form_fields.label: 表锁 Wait
form_fields.description: 采集各表 SQL 锁等待的读写情况。
form_fields.guide_short: 默认关闭。依赖 performance_schema.table_lock_waits_summary_by_table。开启后可采 mysql_table_lock_waits_*（读/写等待次数与耗时汇总）。未启用可能失败；与「表 IO Wait」类似有表级基数，仅排查锁竞争时开启。
form_fields.guide_short_en: Off by default. Metrics: mysql_table_lock_waits_* (read/write wait rates and time) from PERFORMANCE_SCHEMA. May fail if disabled. Per-table cardinality—enable only when diagnosing lock contention.
form_fields.description_en: Collect per-table SQL lock wait for read and write.

advanced_panel.title: 高级采集选项
advanced_panel.hint: 默认即可覆盖连接、QPS、慢查询等 STATUS 指标。展开后按需开关；详细说明见各开关旁「？」指引。
